t: Pack containing everything needed to hang an internal door. Includes a pair of designer handles, and matching tubular latch and ball bearing hinges. Handles are secured with bolt-though fixings, preventing handles from falling off a hollow core door. For use on doors 35-44mm thick and up to 40kg. Supplied with all fixings. Suited thumb-turns available separately.
b: For Use on Doors Up To 40kg
Matching Finish on Handles, Hinges & Latch
